Subject: Quick sync — Exec presence for Redwood demo

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the overview last week — the team liked what they saw. We're trying to lock in a short exec-level demo for the CIO and a couple of VPs to validate latency/cost expectations. The CIO's calendar is tight next week but she indicated two potential windows:

- Thu Oct 3, 10:00–10:40 PDT
- Fri Oct 4, 08:30–09:10 PDT

If neither works, the CIO asked whether the VP of Platform (Victor Lin) could attend in her stead with a follow-up 30min CTO call next week. Can you confirm Redwood exec availability and whether a VP-led session would be acceptable?

A few asks from our side:
- Short, 35–40 minute demo with a focused Q&A at the end
- Brief section on Dedicated vs Private deployment trade-offs for compliance
- Redlined procurement timeline (we'll loop procurement once time is set)

I've attached the RFI summary and our internal holder for context.

Thanks,
Sasha Reed
Director, Platform Strategy
MarketEdge
Attachment: MarketEdge_RFI_notes.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Sasha — thanks for the clear windows. Both look workable on our side with some juggling:

- Thu Oct 3, 10:00–10:40 PDT: Tentative — I can take the first 20 minutes for product + infra and bring Vanessa for the deep compliance/Private deployment section. Priyom can join Q&A.
- Fri Oct 4, 08:30–09:10 PDT: Slight conflict for me but Priyom is covered and Vanessa can lead the session if you prefer VP/Platform to own it.

If the CIO must be present and only those slots work, we can propose a small change: 10:15–10:55 on Thu (still within the CIO's stated availability) so we can guarantee the right cross-functional coverage. Is shifting by 15 minutes acceptable?

If the CIO prefers not to budge, confirming VP attendance (Victor Lin) is totally fine — we usually do an exec handshake intro with the VP and schedule a short CTO follow-up to cover architecture depth.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm which slot you want (Thu 10:00 or Thu 10:15 or Fri 08:30)
- We'll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a short pre-read (10 slides)
- Priyom will handle procurement touchpoints once time is locked

Thanks — looping Priyom and Vanessa to help coordinate availability.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
